x: The two men in front of him were the Holt twins of Hercules----could they do a Milner on us soon? Unfortunately the Gordon Stewart Trophy was held on the same day as the Surrey County Relays so our team was short of sprinters.

Just after the seven miles mark however the Holt twins sped away leaving their adversaries to fight for the minor placings. Geoff secured sixth place in an excellent time of 44:55 just over 200 yards down on Bob Holt.
It was particularly interesting to see how the North brothers and O'Hara held Hercules-Wimbledon's top trio of the Holt twins and Beevor to that two-second margin.
